en.title: trace elements injection (zinc): Table 2 and Table 2 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Table 2 reads “3 kg to 5 kg”. Table 2 reads “5 to 10 kg”. Example: An infant weighing exactly 5 kg matches both zinc rows: 250 and 100 mcg/kg/day. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
